capabilities.title: Capabilities.
capabilities.subtitle: Four disciplines that interlock. Most engagements touch more than one — that is by design, because real engineering problems rarely respect a single discipline.
capabilities.intelligentTagline: AI-assisted design processes, machine learning applications, computer vision systems and data-driven engineering.
capabilities.intelligentBody1: We treat AI as a design partner, not a gimmick. Models are used where they reduce iteration time, surface patterns in complex data or generate candidate geometries that humans can prune and refine.
capabilities.intelligentBody2: Our work spans training pipelines for perception systems, simulation-driven optimisation and the integration of learned components into real products. We choose the simplest model that solves the problem — and we know how to deploy, monitor and retrain it once it leaves the lab.
capabilities.digitalTagline: Advanced CAD modeling, 3D visualization, complex simulation workflows and comprehensive product documentation.
capabilities.digitalBody1: Digital engineering is where ideas become measurable. We build parametric CAD models that survive design reviews, run structural and thermal simulations that actually correlate to test data and produce documentation that engineers on the shop floor can follow without translation.
capabilities.digitalBody2: We work fluently across modern CAD platforms and treat simulation as part of the design loop — not a one-off report at the end.
capabilities.softwareTagline: Full-stack applications, technical platforms, proprietary engineering tools and automation systems.
capabilities.softwareBody1: Most engineering teams are bottlenecked by tooling. We build the software that removes those bottlenecks — internal platforms, automation pipelines and bespoke engineering tools that pay for themselves by saving engineering hours.
capabilities.softwareBody2: We are comfortable across the stack: web front-ends for tools engineers actually use, robust APIs for data exchange and the lower-level code that interfaces with hardware and test rigs.
capabilities.physicalTagline: Rapid prototype development, manufacturing preparation, component engineering, testing and iteration.
capabilities.physicalBody1: A design that has never been built is a hypothesis. We close that loop quickly — prototyping in-house where it makes sense, working with trusted suppliers where it does not and feeding test results back into the next revision.
capabilities.physicalBody2: Our manufacturing preparation work goes beyond drawings: tolerance stack-ups, fastener selection, surface-finish notes and assembly sequencing that survive contact with the shop floor.

automotive.title: The Automotive Roadmap.
automotive.subtitle: Automotive engineering is not a limitation; it is the ultimate stress test. It is one of the most complex engineering environments, combining mechanical systems, software, AI and human interaction.
automotive.lede: The next step is to bring our digital and manufacturing capabilities into the automotive space — engineering improvements that feel inevitable and that respect the original engineering intent of the machine.
automotive.p1Body: We do not sell aftermarket accessories. The work is engineering, not merchandising.
automotive.p2Body: Improvements that change how the vehicle performs, not how it looks bolted on.
automotive.p3Body: Every change is engineered with manufacturing reality — tolerances, cost, supplier capability.
automotive.pillarsTitle: Three pillars the roadmap will be built on.
automotive.pillar1Body: Future systems will be stripped of excess, focusing entirely on structural integrity and computational accuracy. Reflecting strict structural standards and unpainted componentry.
automotive.pillar2Body: Built to survive extreme dynamic loads. We plan to integrate modern AI into mechanical longevity, pushing the boundaries of continuous operation.
automotive.pillar3Body: Riviera is being built as a foundation of pure engineering. We will not build bolt-on parts or cosmetic accessories; we will engineer improvements that elevate the machine from within.
automotive.focus1Desc: Improvements to how the machine performs — power delivery, thermal management, structural efficiency. All driven by measurement, not marketing.
automotive.focus2Desc: Telemetry, sensing and on-vehicle intelligence that turn a car into a measurable, optimisable system rather than a black box.
automotive.focus3Desc: Engineered improvements designed for the realities of production — tolerances, materials, supplier capability and cost are part of the brief from day one.
automotive.closingTitle: If this is the kind of work you want done
automotive.closingBody: We are at the early stage of this roadmap. That is a feature, not a bug — it means the approach can be designed with you, not bolted on after the fact.

founder.title: The Multidisciplinary Advantage.
founder.subtitle: A technologist and engineer driven by a lifelong curiosity to understand what is possible.
founder.bio1: Riviera Engineering was founded on the belief that the most useful engineers are the ones who refuse to specialise into irrelevance. Software, AI, computer vision, CAD, simulation, manufacturing — these are not separate careers; they are the tools of one job, which is to understand a problem deeply enough to solve it correctly.
founder.bio2: The founder has spent over seven years working across these areas, both independently and as part of teams that shipped. That breadth is deliberate. It means a brief does not get routed to "whoever owns that silo" — it gets worked by someone who can hold the whole picture and decide which discipline actually owns the problem.
founder.bio3: The roadmap into automotive is the next chapter, not a pivot. It applies the same multidisciplinary approach to a domain that is unforgiving in a way that produces better engineers.
founder.quoteBold: Build what has not yet been possible.
founder.principlesTitle: Five values that govern the work.
founder.v1Body: Every project starts with the question "why is it built this way?" — and that question is treated as a deliverable, not a distraction. The willingness to read the manual, run the test or sketch the alternative is the cheapest competitive advantage in engineering and it is increasingly rare.
founder.v2Body: Every drawing, every line of code, every fastener selection carries an intent. Precision is not perfectionism — it is removing the things that exist for no reason, so what remains can be defended.
founder.v3Body: Real problems cross disciplines. The interesting work happens at the boundary between mechanical, electronic, software and human factors — and the value is in connecting them, not in choosing a side.
founder.v4Body: New tools earn their place by being the simplest solution to a real problem, not by being new. AI, additive manufacturing and modern simulation are useful because they change what is possible — but only when they earn the complexity they introduce.
founder.v5Body: Work should be presentable. Documentation, models, code and finished parts all carry the same signal: this was cared for. Clients notice, suppliers notice and future-you notices most of all.
founder.ctaBody: Send a brief, an introduction or just a question. We read everything that comes through.
